package_info.why_malicious: This article does not describe a specific malicious package or code. Instead, it discusses the risks of using open source components and containers without proper governance, highlighting that many organizations use vulnerable or risky components, which can lead to security breaches.

behavioral_signatures: Use of outdated or vulnerable open source components
Inclusion of third-party containers from unverified sources
Lack of automated policy enforcement for component selection
file_indicators: Presence of components with known CVEs
Containers sourced from public repositories without verification
network_indicators: No direct network indicators provided in the article
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Implement automated tools to scan for known vulnerabilities (CVEs) in open source components and containers during the build and deployment process. Enforce open source governance policies to ensure only approved, secure, and up-to-date components are used. Monitor for the use of components with risky licenses or outdated versions.
